name: Project Context is reachable from the sidebar
description: From the seeded repo's PR list, click the WORKSPACE sidebar item 'Project Context' and confirm the /repos/<id>/context route loads. The page body is either the document list or the 'Repository not cloned yet' state depending on whether the seeded repo has a clone, so the flow asserts only the route and the page chrome (no model call, read-only). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).

steps.label: click the Project Context sidebar item
